edbDesc: The motion of liquid induced by an applied potential across a capillary tube or microchannel. Electroosmotic flow is an essential component in chemical separation techniques, notably capillary electrophoresis. Electroosmotic flow can occur in natural unfiltered water, as well as buffered solutions.
title: Electro-Osmotic Flow
pickWhy: The same effect as Electro-Osmosis, described as a flow; merged into that card.
